title: Don't Let the Pigeon Stay Up Late!
author: Mo Willems

hero.name: Pigeon
hero.description: Mo Willems' distinctive cartoon pigeon — simple blue-grey bird with one large round eye and an orange beak, iconic character from the Pigeon series
hero.source_note: Named/distinctive character — source from Creative Fabrica, TPT, or Mo Willems licensed clip art; generic Boardmaker pigeon will not match

ambiguous.issue: Could mean a lamp/light source (noun) or the adjective light (not heavy)
ambiguous.reason: The bedside lamp is a key story prop; 'lamp' is unambiguous and already in fringe

ambiguous.issue: Could mean a star in the sky (noun) or a celebrity/star shape
ambiguous.reason: Book is set at bedtime; stars in the night sky are part of the setting

notes: The hot dog is a recurring Pigeon series motif and the pigeon uses wanting a hot dog as a stalling tactic to avoid bedtime — high engagement word for fans of the series. 'Tired' and 'awake' are opposites that work well together on this board and support the core 'same/different' row. Several words (bed, moon, star, lamp, pillow, night, tired) are already present in activity_images or aac_extras per existing data — confirm exact filenames before generating new PNGs. 'Dream' may need sourcing; search Boardmaker for 'dream' or 'dreaming'. The pigeon character MUST be sourced externally as Mo Willems' style is highly distinctive and students familiar with the book will not accept a generic bird.

matching.note: Min 4 approved stems, no hard cap

cvc_decode.note: 3-5 groups x 3 CVC words (phonics, not theme icons)
